result:
**STOP — needs B ruling on A-R459-REVIEW-R1, a Medium regression against HEAD. The fix is in code whose hashes the task pins, so I didn't change it.**

**The problem:** sometimes the page's HTML doesn't match what React expects when it starts up (React #418, a hydration mismatch). React then rebuilds the whole page in the browser. The new cover's state is stored on a `<style>` tag that React owns, so the rebuild throws it away and the entrance never plays.
- I reproduced it in Chromium on production builds by inserting one `<div>` into `<body>` before React starts.
- **Tree:** the overlay never appeared in 3 of 3 runs.
- **HEAD 891dc0f:** with the same insertion, the overlay still played (1 of 1).
- The reviewer believes browser extensions often cause this kind of mismatch; I only tested the inserted `<div>`, not a real extension.
- The reviewer also says the early key and click listeners stay attached for the rest of the tab in this case. I didn't measure that.
- B's planning files (`sketch-review.md`, `pd-consult.md`) don't cover this case.
- **Reviewer's suggested fix (not applied):** keep that state on a typed `window` global instead of the `<style>` tag, and add a test that replaces the tag. This changes `EntranceCover.tsx`, `SpotlightLoader.tsx` and the test file, which C3, the claims and the mutant list all pin.

**What I did:**
- B's patch is applied unchanged; all 4 file hashes match.
- I wrote doc 300 (line 3 has the date, line 4 reads `Completed (C round 459 PASS)`, and `pending` doesn't appear). After the review I corrected its wording for R6 and R7.
- Only the 5 granted files changed.

**Every check matched B's expected values:**
- Claims before and after match, with empty stderr; after the doc edit they still match.
- Typecheck passes and lint reports 207 warnings.
- Biome on the 4 code files shows exactly the 6 expected diagnostics.
- The covering tests pass: 11 files, 201 tests.
- The mutant check matches B's 20 lines.
- **Browser, 1440×900, normal CPU speed:**
  - On a fresh tab the first painted frame is black, and the cover lasts 1526 ms (expected 1400–1700).
  - On reload no black frame appears.
- I didn't run the full test suite, `npm run verify` or the end-to-end tests; the root gate runs them. The production build did complete during the browser check.

**Other reviewer findings, passed to B:**
- **Low:**
  - R2: the early listeners never time out on their own.
  - R3: if the `--color-black` variable stops being generated, the cover would silently be transparent.
  - R8: a few gaps in the tests.
- **Info:**
  - R4: if a Content Security Policy is added later, these inline tags will need hashes.
  - R5: opening `/` in a background tab uses up the once-per-tab entrance (a question for Saba).
- Its architecture note (move this hand-off into `app/lib/entrance-handshake.ts`, only if R1 is accepted) is recorded for B; I didn't act on it.

**For C:** started through the loop's symlinked path, the mock API exits silently. Start it with `setsid nohup node $(realpath /home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop)/mock-api/server.mjs &`. My repro script for R1 is `a-round-459/r1/r1-repro.mjs`.

I read the pre-flight checklist only after applying B's patch, and read three of the reference documents only in part; the report says so. I haven't marked any C acceptance row as passed, and the round is not complete. The production servers on ports 5190 and 5191 are stopped, I didn't touch the dev server on 5173, and the mock API on 5199 is still running.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-459.md`, with evidence in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-459/`.
